name: octaweave_get_note
description: Fetch one note by id OR slug. Returns the summary fields plus `body` (markdown — the source of truth), `html` (server-rendered, sanitized; for display only), `backlinks` (notes linking here), and `broken_links` (slugs this note links to that do not exist yet). KEEP THE `version` — you must send it as base_version when you edit.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
